identifiers.title: HEART
identifiers.definition: The parent profile of HEART (Hypermedia Engine for Agentic Resource Transitions). A response names it beside the concrete dialect profile, in Link: rel="profile". It is never negotiated alone. A client that knows it knows that the response follows HEART's rules: state and legal acts in one representation, acts conditional on the representation's validator, and shared layers checked by integrity.

identifiers.title: HAL Schema Forms, HEART profile
identifiers.definition: HAL Schema Forms (https://github.com/jbadeau/hal-schema-forms) with HEART's additions: template pointers, integrity on shared links, schemas by $ref, forms named by link relation and described by ALPS, and refusals as problem details. An L0 response stays valid upstream HAL Schema Forms. Media type application/hal+json.

identifiers.title: HAL-FORMS, HEART on-ramp
identifiers.definition: HAL-FORMS (application/prs.hal-forms+json) as HEART's on-ramp dialect, served at L0 only. Its templates are keyed by act name, and it is computed from the same legality decision as HAL Schema Forms, so both dialects always offer the same acts.

identifiers.title: forms
identifiers.definition: Links a resource's state (Layer 1) to its affordance set: the forms legal in its current state, shared by every resource in that state. The link carries integrity, a W3C Subresource Integrity value, and the client checks the set's bytes against it before use. Written as the CURIE hr:forms.

identifiers.title: unavailable
identifiers.definition: Links to a list of the acts that are not offered in this state, each with the server's reason. A client fetches it only when someone asks why an act is missing, checks it against the link's integrity, and never acts on what it lists. Written as the CURIE hr:unavailable.

identifiers.title: The act is stale: the state has changed
identifiers.definition: 412. The act's If-Match no longer names the resource's current representation: someone else changed it first. The client re-reads the resource and decides again. It never resends the act.

identifiers.title: The act is not offered in the resource's current state
identifiers.definition: 409. The act is not legal in the resource's current state, however current the client's view. The client re-reads, and does not retry.

identifiers.title: The body does not match the form's schema
identifiers.definition: 422. The body breaks the form's JSON Schema. The problem lists each violation with a JSON Pointer. Not retried.

identifiers.title: A rule of the resource refuses the act
identifiers.definition: 422. The body satisfies the schema, but a rule of the resource that the schema cannot express refuses it, in the rule's own words, with a JSON Pointer. Not retried.

identifiers.title: If-Match is required
identifiers.definition: 428. An act was sent without If-Match. Every HEART act is conditional on the representation the client read.

identifiers.title: A credential is needed
identifiers.definition: 401. The resource needs a Basic or Bearer credential the service admits; the response offers a WWW-Authenticate challenge for each. A wrong credential is answered exactly as a missing one.

identifiers.title: The HEART specification
identifiers.definition: The specification a service's home document names as describedBy.

identifiers.title: Home document variables
identifiers.definition: The home document names each template variable by a URI under /vars/: {noun}-id and {noun}-name, such as /vars/bed-id. Each is the identifier, or the name, of one resource of the type the noun names.
